name: 4dgspl
description: Turn synchronized multi-camera video or a Blender multi-camera render into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) on 4dgspl.at: validate, upload, process, download.
long_description: 4dgspl.at converts synchronized video of the same moment from 4–16 cameras (or virtual cameras in Blender, Unreal or Unity) plus COLMAP calibration into a 4D Gaussian Splatting sequence that plays in the browser and can be watched from any angle. This server lets an AI assistant explain the capture rules, validate a delivery folder, create a project, upload the videos and calibration, submit it, follow its progress and download the per-frame 3DGS PLY files. New accounts get 5 free jobs.
